title: Naomi Cesar hopes to inspire next generation after historic Youth Olympics silver
summary: After winning a historic silver medal at the 2026 Youth Olympic Games, track star Naomi Cesar is hopeful that her feat will encourage other young Filipinas to pursue their dreams.
